description: Delete a skill for good. Identify it by skill_id, or by name (plus brain_id/agent_id when the name is not unique). A name matching several skills is REFUSED and lists them rather than picking one. To keep the success counters and merely take a skill out of circulation, use save_skill with status instead — list_skills only shows active ones. IRREVERSIBLE.

name.description: Skill name, alternative to skill_id; refused if ambiguous

skill_id.description: ID of the skill to delete

name: delete_skill
